notes:
Fixed by the review run, then approved:
1. Title: "Agent rules are arriving from banks and regulators" -> "Banks spell out agent terms as Singapore plans a sandbox". Source: MAS/FFI announce a sandbox for testing, not rules; "FFI will establish an Agentic Money Sandbox".
2. Dek: "Singapore is opening a sandbox" -> "an institute in Singapore will set up a sandbox" (source: "FFI will establish").
3. Heading "Singapore builds a test bed" -> "Singapore plans a test bed" (future, not built).
4. Last section: "a regulator-backed sandbox is testing the limits" -> "a sandbox announced with MAS will test the limits" (source: MAS and FFI jointly announced; sandbox "will enable participants to test").
